summary: Iter 212m-23 backend-only E2E verification on PREVIEW. All 20 targeted tests pass (9 source-pin + 6 cold-start + 5 new live E2E). Eager build_url_context() scraper is fully removed from chat.py (only present in comments/NOTE lines). On PREVIEW backend, URL prompts now dispatch fetch_url via standard orchestration with forced:true marker and emit a '📖 Reading URL…' step card; non-URL prompts do NOT trigger forced pre-fetch (regression-safe). context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 212m-23 fix is FULLY VERIFIED on PREVIEW. Live SSE proof transcript (captured by /tmp/capture_proof.py): URL prompt 'Read https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/ and summarise the first H1.' → HTTP 200, 7.4s, step frames include '📖 Reading URL…' and '📖 Scraping web…', 10 fetch_url invocations with forced:True (status=error due to Tavily 432 quota — expected, billing not code), 0 tool_call/arg_value leaks in user tokens. Plain 'hello' → 0 fetch_url invocations, 2.3s. build_url_context only appears in chat.py as a NOTE comment on line 25 and a doc-comment on line 1078. The wider regression suite (iter129/130 persona size pins, iter86 hard_timeout pin) has pre-existing failures unrelated to this change and were not in scope.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: eager build_url_context() ran in parallel with the LLM call and stuffed scraped HTML into extra_system_prompt without going through tool orchestration → no step card, no tool_invocations log, no web_sources chips, and (worst) the model sometimes echoed raw <tool_call> tags into the user-visible token stream. Real fix in this iteration: (1) DELETED the eager call site in routers/chat.py — replaced with NOTE comments and `repo_ctx = await get_repo_context(...)` only; (2) ADDED a FORCED URL PRE-FETCH block in services/orchestrator.py BEFORE the main reasoning loop that detects URLs via extract_urls(prompt)[:3] and invokes fetch_url through the standard invoke_local_tool/invoke_tool path, appending a {'forced': True} entry to invocations[] and emitting step_hook with _STEP_LABELS['fetch_url']. Result: URLs now route through standard tool dispatch → step cards appear, invocations are logged, no raw tool_call leakage, and non-URL prompts are untouched. Verified live against PREVIEW backend with founder account.
